title: Tiny, cute fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#2a4a6a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='6' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='3' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='6' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='3' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- main body back -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='40' height='30' rx='3' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- main body front cab -->
  <path d='M14,50 Q14,40 24,40 L42,40 L42,72 L14,72 Z' fill='#ff4040'/>
  <!-- lighter panel on cab -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ff8888'/>
  <rect x='18' y='62' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ff8888'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='26' y='44' width='12' height='10' rx='2' fill='#88ddff'/>
  <!-- body stripe -->
  <rect x='38' y='56' width='40' height='4' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  <!-- equipment on top -->
  <rect x='42' y='34' width='24' height='8' rx='2' fill='#d0d0e0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='30' width='4' height='4' fill='#ffdd00'/>
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='4' height='4' fill='#ffdd00'/>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='44' y='20' width='4' height='14' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='20' width='4' height='14' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='22' width='20' height='2' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='26' width='20' height='2' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='20' height='2' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='10' y='68' width='8' height='4' rx='1' fill='#dddddd'/>
  <rect x='38' y='68' width='40' height='4' rx='1' fill='#dddddd'/>
  <!-- light on top -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='3' fill='#ffdd00'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- rear light -->
  <rect x='74' y='52' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffaa00'/>
</svg>
